people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus looked around, and said to his disciples, “How difficult it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!”
translations.bsb: Then Jesus looked around and said to His disciples, “How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!”
translations.kjv: And Jesus looked round about, and saith unto his disciples, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
translations.asv: And Jesus looked round about, and saith unto his disciples, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
